stories.title: Montrealers could face nearly 10% property tax hike in 2027
stories.summary: The city says the increase is largely tied to new investments in aging infrastructure, including maintenance and Montreal's water systems.

stories.title: Dylan Larkin to make Montreal Canadiens debut against Los Angeles Kings
stories.summary: Dylan Larkin will make his Montreal Canadiens debut Monday night.

stories.title: Quebec Premier says he ‘cannot’ take an oath to the King despite court ruling
stories.summary: Quebec Superior Court has ruled that the province's politicians will need to swear an oath to the King in order to sit at the provincial legislature.

stories.title: Two Americans sentenced to life in prison for murder of Quebec entrepreneur, partner
stories.summary: Two Americans convicted of murdering Quebec entrepreneur Daniel Langlois and his partner Dominique Marchand in Dominica are set to be sentenced Monday.

stories.title: Montreal Canadiens acquire Dylan Larkin from Detroit Red Wings
stories.summary: Canadiens fans serenaded Dylan Larkin with chants of "We Want Larkin!" last month.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Philadelphia Flyers upset the Montreal Canadiens as the home woes continue
stories.summary: After a huge win over the Stanley Cup champions Thursday night, the challenge on Saturday was to keep the same intensity against the Philadelphia Flyers.

stories.title: Quebec students consider general strike to protest affordability crisis
stories.summary: Students are set to vote on the strike after a general assembly that began in the early afternoon at the Université du Québec à Montréal.

stories.title: 2 former Montreal police officers charged in misconduct investigation
stories.summary: The Montreal Police Service said Saturday the two former officers were part of the seven who had recently been administratively dismissed.

stories.title: N.B. government in talks with Quebec firm about restarting idled Nackawic pulp mill
stories.summary: Provincial Natural Resources Minister John Herron issued a statement Friday saying government officials are talking to Arbec Forest Products Inc., based in Saint-Léonard, Que.

stories.title: Quebec pledges to unveil a road map for phasing out fossil fuels
stories.summary: Quebec has pledged to create a road map for its transition away from fossil fuels, sparking a wave of congratulations from environmental organizations.
